title: Research Summary of the Lausanne Seoul Statement (2024): Baptism and the Lord's Supper
author: Open Christian Data contributors
tradition_notes: Editorial research summary of sacramental teaching in a global evangelical statement. Lausanne is a movement, not a denomination, and the source also draws on broader catholic language about the church and sacraments.

source.name: Lausanne Movement
source.license_notes: No statement-specific public reproduction grant was found. The full source text is excluded from this public dataset; this record contains only an original research summary without source quotations.

processing.notes: The parser checks three sacramental source anchors, then emits a short original summary. It does not reproduce the 97-point Seoul Statement or its four endnotes.
